description:
Flippo keeps a reseller's inventory, purchases and sales in one place.

Ask what is still unsold, what a purchase returned, or how much profit a
month brought in, and the answer comes from your own records.

You can look up items, see what has been sitting too long, compare margins
across platforms, and record a sale as it happens.

Requires a Flippo account.

defaultPrompt: How did my reselling business do last month?
I paid 100 for a box of 12 games. Add it as a purchase.
Which of my items are not listed anywhere yet?
